messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Telugu) | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------|--------| | **A** | preposition (dative) “to” | **నీ** | “to you” (part of dative) | OK | | **te** | 2nd‑person pronoun (accusative) “you” | **కు** | “to” (dative marker) | OK | | **convien** | impersonal verb “it behoves / it is necessary” | **తీసుకోవాలి** | “must take / have to hold” | OK | | **tenere** | infinitive “to hold / to keep” | **తీసుకోవాలి** | “must take / have to hold” | OK | | **altro** | adjective “another” | **మరో** | “another” | OK | | **vïaggio** | noun “journey / course” | **ప్రయాణం** | “journey” | OK | | **rispuose** | verb “replied” | **ప్రతిస్పందించాడు** | “replied” | OK | | **poi** | adverb “after / when” | **చూసి** | “having seen” (temporal) | OK | | **che** | conjunction “that / when” | **చూసి** | “having seen” (subordinator) | OK | | **lagrimar** | infinitive “to weep” | **కన్నీరు పోస్తున్నాను** | “(I) am shedding tears” | OK | | **mi** | pronoun “me” (accusative) | **నన్ను** | “me” | OK | | **vide** | verb “saw” | **చూసి** | “having seen” | OK | | **se** | conjunction “if” (conditional) | **విడిచిపోవాలనుకుంటే** | “if (you) wish to leave” | OK | | **vuo'** | verb “wish / want” | **విడిచిపోవాలనుకుంటే** | “if (you) wish to leave” | OK | | **campar** | infinitive “to escape / to leave” | **విడిచిపోవాలనుకుంటే** | “if (you) wish to leave” | OK | | **d'** | preposition “from” | *(omitted)* | – | **UNNECESSARY** (Telugu marks the source case on *స్థలాన్ని*; no separate preposition needed) | | **esto** | demonstrative adjective “this” | **ఈ** | “this” | OK | | **loco** | noun “place” | **స్థలాన్ని** | “place (accusative)” | OK | | **selvaggio** | adjective “savage / wild” | **క్రూరమైన** | “savage” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **d'** – marked **UNNECESSARY** because Telugu expresses the “from” relation through case marking on *స్థలాన్ని*; a separate preposition is not required.
All other source words are adequately rendered, with correct grammatical agreement and no missing or erroneous translations.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: నీకు మరో ప్రయాణం తీసుకోవాలి, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 2: - Original: అతను నన్ను కన్నీరు పోస్తున్నాను చూసి ప్రతిస్పందించాడు, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 3: - Original: నీవు ఈ క్రూరమైన స్థలాన్ని విడిచిపోవాలనుకుంటే; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` నీకు మరో ప్రయాణం తీసుకోవాలి, అతను నన్ను కన్నీరు పోస్తున్నాను చూసి ప్రతిస్పందించాడు, నీవు ఈ క్రూరమైన స్థలాన్ని విడిచిపోవాలనుకుంటే; ```
